messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate observed on embeddings-prod (route: /v1/embeddings). Current p95 latency also up. PagerDuty: PD-4332 triggered.

priya.k: seeing it. I’m oncall primary for the next 2h — taking lead. @sam.t please stand by as secondary.

sam.t: acknowledged. I’ll watch alerts and take pager if you need to escalate.

priya.k: quick customer impact check — traffic shows failures for ~7% of requests, mostly clients with long seqs. No active SSO customers reported yet, but we should assume partial degradation.

jonathan: FYI we rolled the quantized LLM variant in eu-west earlier — could be related. I’ll check recent deploys.

maria.g: adding runbook pointer: https://confluence.redwood/inference/runbooks/embeddings-prod-runbook — see sections "live mitigation" and "fallback to cpu-quant".

priya.k: thanks. Running quick health checks:
```bash
# check pods and recent restarts
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=embeddings -o wide
kubectl -n inference logs -l app=embeddings --since=10m | tail -n 200\```

priya.k: logs show repeated OOMs on gpu-node-14 and backend returning 503 when KV cache misses spike. Possible memory regression after the recent kernel change.

jonathan: opening ticket RED-3210 to capture the memory regression and link to PD. I’ll pin stack traces there.

pagerduty-bot: PD-4332 acknowledged by priya.k. Incident severity: sev2. Estimated time to impact reduction: unknown.

sam.t: temp mitigation suggestion: reduce batch size and enable prefix caching to avoid thrash. We can patch config via /ops api: POST /config/embeddings {"batch_size":64, "prefix_cache":true}.

priya.k: applying conservative patch now. Will monitor.

priya.k: patch applied, restarting small subset (canary) of pods to pick up config.

maria.g: note — we should also consider reverting the kernel flag from last deploy if canary doesn't stabilize. Runbook step 4 covers rollback command.

priya.k: canary looks better after 5m: error rate down to ~1.5%, latency improving. Rolling patch to rest of cluster with 1m stagger.

jonathan: I’ve started a parallel investigation into recently merged PR #2048 (gpu-memory-allocator). Tagging the PR and collecting heap dumps.

sam.t: are there any coverage gaps coming up? My follow period ends in 90 minutes and there’s a gap in EU midnight coverage if we both hand off early.

priya.k: good catch. @maria.g can you cover EU overlap 00:00-02:00 UTC? If not, we need on-call swap.

maria.g: I can take the overlap 00:00-01:00 UTC but I have a hard block at 01:00—need someone for 01:00-02:00.

priya.k: jonathan, can you shift 01:00-02:00? You’re in a different timezone, but if you can spare the hour that plugs the gap.

jonathan: I can cover 01:00-02:00. Confirmed.

priya.k: thanks team. Current mitigation seems effective. I’m going to prepare the formal post-handoff notes.

priya.k: action items before I hand primary to jonathan at 02:00 UTC: 
- File follow-up bug for kernel allocator (RED-3210) and assign to eng-ml
- Schedule short retro (30min) tomorrow 15:30 UTC in #eng-oncall
- Create observability ticket to add KV cache hitrate dashboard and an alert (ENGOPS-78)
- Update runbook with the kernel-flag and prefix-cache troubleshooting steps

sam.t: I opened ENGOPS-78 for dashboards/alerts and linked to RED-3210.

jonathan: I’ll own RED-3210 triage. I’ll upload heap dumps and link PR + metric diffs.

maria.g: I’ll update the runbook page with the rollback command and add a short blurb about batch-size tuning.

pagerduty-bot: PD-4332 status changed to "mitigated" by priya.k.

priya.k: handing off primary at 02:00 UTC to @jonathan. Secondary remains @sam.t for the remainder of his shift. Please note coverage: 01:00-02:00 covered by jonathan, 00:00-01:00 by maria.g.

priya.k: summary to paste into incident tracker: "Partial degradation in embeddings-prod due to GPU memory thrash after recent allocator change. Mitigated by reducing batch size and enabling prefix cache. Ongoing: RED-3210 for allocator regression; ENGOPS-78 to add cache hitrate dashboard/alert. No customers reported full outage; estimated impacted request volume peaked at 7% and is now ~1%."

sam.t: nice work all. Retro invite sent to #eng-oncall for 30m tomorrow 15:30 UTC. Agenda: timeline, root cause hypotheses, runbook gaps, action owners.

jonathan: I’ve accepted and will join the retro. I’ll prepare the initial triage notes for RED-3210.

maria.g: accepted. I’ll bring the updated runbook draft.

priya.k: thanks — leaving the thread. If any regression appears while you’re primary, escalate PD and call the pager.

jonathan: taking over primary now. I'll post a quick status update 30m in with any changes.

incident-bot: THREAD CLOSED: last status posted by jonathan at 1718013600.
